title: Pool Structure, Render & Water Test (Riding School – Neuman Aqua)
activity: Swimming pool: setting out, pipework test, rebar, sprayed shell, render, membrane, 7-day water test
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Pool structure set out to the drawings and site grid?
questions.source: Neuman Aqua pool ITP NAL-00001 item 3

questions.q: Circulation pipework and built-in items (inlets, sumps, lights) set out to the drawings?
questions.source: Neuman Aqua pool ITP NAL-00001 items 6–7

questions.q: Pipework pressure tested (2 bar) before the concrete is sprayed?
questions.source: Neuman Aqua pool ITP NAL-00001 item 8 – hold point

questions.q: Rebar the right size and number, tied, on spacers/chairs, cover right, no heavy rust?
questions.source: Neuman Aqua pool ITP NAL-00001 – pre-pour checklist

questions.q: Starter bars and splices in the right position, size and number?
questions.source: Neuman Aqua pool ITP NAL-00001 – pre-pour checklist

questions.q: Sprayed shell: no honeycombing, cracks, air pockets or exposed rebar?
questions.source: Neuman Aqua pool ITP NAL-00001 item 11 – concrete visual check
Neuman Aqua pool ITP NAL-00001 item 11
Neuman Aqua pool ITP NAL-00001 – render check sheet

questions.q: Render flat – within ±3 mm over 1 m?
questions.source: Neuman Aqua pool ITP NAL-00001 item 13 – render check sheet

questions.q: No cracks or gaps, sharp corners formed?
questions.source: Neuman Aqua pool ITP NAL-00001 – render check sheet

questions.q: Membrane in two perpendicular coats, no patches or bubbles?
questions.source: Neuman Aqua pool ITP NAL-00001 item 15

questions.q: Pool filled at max 1.0 m depth per 24 h, to within 25 mm of the outlet level?
questions.source: Neuman Aqua pool ITP NAL-00001 – water test procedure 1

questions.q: 7-day test: no measurable drop (after evaporation) and no damp patches on accessible faces?
questions.source: Neuman Aqua pool ITP NAL-00001 item 16; procedure 3–5

questions.q: Any failure reported straight away, repaired and re-tested?
questions.source: Neuman Aqua pool ITP NAL-00001 – procedure 6–8
